_doc: Every outbound HTTP call this plugin makes, keyed 'file :: function', and where its target comes from.
target: constant (a provider URL in code), setting (an admin-set host or region), site (this site's own URL),
or member (input a member can set). A member target uses wp_safe_remote_* or names in limited_by the
function that bounds the host. OutboundHttpAuthorityTest tokenises src/ and fails on an undeclared call,
a stale entry, a missing reason, or an unbounded member target.

src/Services/GalleryService.php :: rende.reason: An embed URL stored in the service gallery meta, sent to oEmbed.

src/Services/RealtimeService.php :: publ.reason: Admin-set Pusher cluster or self-hosted host (Advanced > Realtime). Only manage_options can change it.

src/functions/catalog.php :: wpss_get_vi.reason: A vendor's gallery video URL, sent to oEmbed discovery for a poster.

src/functions/files.php :: wpss_order_fi.reason: Probes this site's own uploads URL to see whether order files are publicly served.
